---
title: Reference
---

Find a reminder, then return to the worked lesson when you need its reasoning. The Python examples on these pages execute during the website build. Stata and R expressions are reading bridges; those programs are not required or tested here.

- [Stata → Python](stata-python.qmd): loading, selection, grouping, safe joins, panel reshaping and regression conventions.
- [R → Python](r-python.qmd): DataFrames, explicit sample selection, formulas and differences that need checking.
- [pandas quick reference](pandas.qmd): inspection, missingness, transformations, group summaries, joins and reshaping.
- [Glossary](glossary.qmd): programming, measurement, modelling and reproducibility terms.
- [Common errors and fixes](errors.qmd): read the error, inspect the relevant contract and verify the repair.

Use the [course map](../lessons/index.qmd) for the full sequence. [Part 5](../lessons/05-workflow/01-local-installation.ipynb) explains local setup and reproducible work; the [guided projects](../projects/index.qmd) provide practice on new real public-data questions.
